preprocessing.grayscale: first channel if RGB, else as-is
preprocessing.orientation: native; ground truth relabelled WITHOUT transpose
preprocessing.intensity_units: raw image units (8-bit 0-255 for these files)
preprocessing.per_tile_standardization: z-score per tile, inverted before thresholding

coordinates: joint 2D X=(row,col) linearly mapped to [0,1]^2 per tile

determinism.reason: gpytorch max_cholesky_size=800 would otherwise estimate the log-determinant with 10 random probe vectors; unseeded, that alone moved the fitted lengthscale by ~1.8e-3 between identical reruns

thresholding.scope: per tile, then outlier-tile re-threshold at the non-outlier mean

markers.empty_component_policy: one marker at the component's distance-transform argmax (first in C raster order)

evaluation.mean_matched_iou: max IoU per GT instance, averaged over ALL GT instances (undetected contribute 0)
